summary: A hero-sized empty state inviting the user to start a first project, with Create project and Import buttons.
use: Onboarding screens for an empty workspace where the page has nothing else to show.
spec: `<EmptyState variant="hero" icon={Inbox} title="Start your first project"`
`description="Projects keep your sessions, contacts and settings in one place."`
`{#snippet actions()}` holds `<Button variant="filled">Create project</Button>` and `<Button variant="ghost">Import</Button>`
Both buttons use the default size, with no size attribute
